```{=html}
<section class="level1" id="refaire-toute-la-chaîne">
<h1>Refaire toute la chaîne</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-programme">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-programme">Le programme</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce chapitre reprend les quatorze précédents</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">

<tr class="header">
<th>Étape</th>
<th>Chapitres</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<td>Importer et décrire les variables</td>
<td>2</td>
</tr>

</tr>

<section class="level2" id="le-programme-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-programme-suite">Le programme (suite)</h2>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le but n’est pas d’apprendre R</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>C’est de <strong>vérifier</strong> que les résultats calculés à la main sont bien ceux que produit un logiciel — et de constater que quinze lignes de code remplacent un semestre de calculs.</p>
<p>Comprendre la formule reste indispensable : c’est ce qui permet de savoir <strong>quelle</strong> fonction demander et de reconnaître un résultat aberrant.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="charger-et-explorer">
<h1>Charger et explorer</h1>
<section class="level2" id="limport">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="limport">L’import</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Les données : 500 salariés, six colonnes</span></span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">str</span>(sal)</span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">head</span>(sal)</span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">summary</span>(sal)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La sortie de str()</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<pre><code>'data.frame': 500 obs. of  6 variables:
 $ id        : int  1 2 3 4 5 ...
 $ salaire   : int  8540 7100 4380 ...
 $ anciennete: int  10 15 4 ...
 $ diplome   : Factor w/ 3 levels "Bac","Bac+2","Bac+5"
 $ region    : Factor w/ 4 levels "Autres","Casablanca",...
 $ sexe      : Factor w/ 2 levels "F","H"</code></pre>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="limport-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="limport-suite">L’import (suite)</h2>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le premier réflexe : vérifier les types</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>Factor</code> pour les qualitatives, <code>int</code> ou <code>num</code> pour les quantitatives.</p>
<p>Si R a lu <code>salaire</code> comme un facteur, c’est qu’une ligne contient du texte — un espace, une virgule décimale, un « n.d. ». <strong>Toutes les moyennes seraient alors impossibles.</strong></p>
<p>C’est la première erreur à chercher, et elle survient dans un fichier réel sur deux.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-contrôle-des-manquants">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-contrôle-des-manquants">Le contrôle des manquants</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">colSums</span>(<span class="fu">is.na</span>(sal))          <span class="co"># combien de valeurs manquantes par colonne</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">nrow</span>(sal)                    <span class="co"># 500</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">length</span>(<span class="fu">unique</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire))  <span class="co"># 381 valeurs distinctes</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Pourquoi 381 valeurs distinctes comptent</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>C’est le critère du chapitre 1 : <span class="math inline">381</span> valeurs pour <span class="math inline">500</span> individus, donc on traitera le salaire comme <strong>continu</strong> et on le regroupera en classes.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="le-tableau-statistique">
<h1>Le tableau statistique</h1>
<section class="level2" id="variable-qualitative">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="variable-qualitative">Variable qualitative</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a>n  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">nrow</span>(sal)</span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-2" tabindex="-1"></a>ni <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome)                 <span class="co"># effectifs</span></span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-3" tabindex="-1"></a>fi <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">prop.table</span>(ni)                     <span class="co"># fréquences</span></span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-4" tabindex="-1"></a>Ni <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cumsum</span>(ni)                         <span class="co"># effectifs cumulés</span></span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-5" tabindex="-1"></a>Fi <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cumsum</span>(fi)                         <span class="co"># fréquences cumulées</span></span>
<span id="cb4-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-7" tabindex="-1"></a>tableau <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">data.frame</span>(ni, <span class="at">fi =</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(fi),</span>
<span id="cb4-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-8" tabindex="-1"></a>                      <span class="at">Ni =</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(Ni), <span class="at">Fi =</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(Fi))</span>
<span id="cb4-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">print</span>(tableau, <span class="at">digits =</span> <span class="dv">3</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le résultat</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<pre><code>   Var1 Freq    fi  Ni    Fi
1   Bac  219 0.438 219 0.438
2 Bac+2  174 0.348 393 0.786
3 Bac+5  107 0.214 500 1.000</code></pre>
<p>Exactement le tableau du chapitre 2.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="variable-continue-le-découpage-en-classes">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="variable-continue-le-découpage-en-classes">Variable continue : le découpage en classes</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb6-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a>bornes <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">2000</span>, <span class="dv">4000</span>, <span class="dv">6000</span>, <span class="dv">8000</span>, <span class="dv">10000</span>, <span class="dv">14000</span>, <span class="dv">20000</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a>cl <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cut</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, <span class="at">breaks =</span> bornes, <span class="at">right =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)   <span class="co"># [a ; b[</span></span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a>ni <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(cl)</span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>ai <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">diff</span>(bornes)                        <span class="co"># amplitudes</span></span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>di <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(ni) <span class="sc">/</span> ai                 <span class="co"># densités</span></span>
<span id="cb6-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">data.frame</span>(<span class="at">classe =</span> <span class="fu">names</span>(ni), <span class="at">ni =</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(ni),</span>
<span id="cb6-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-8" tabindex="-1"></a>           <span class="at">fi =</span> <span class="fu">as.numeric</span>(ni)<span class="sc">/</span>n, ai, di)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’argument right = FALSE est essentiel</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Par défaut, R crée des classes <span class="math inline">]a\,;\,b]</span> — <strong>ouvertes à gauche</strong>, fermées à droite. C’est l’inverse de la convention française.</p>
<p><code>right = FALSE</code> rétablit <span class="math inline">[a\,;\,b[</span>. Sans lui, tous les effectifs sont décalés aux bornes.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="les-graphiques">
<h1>Les graphiques</h1>
<section class="level2" id="les-quatre-représentations">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-quatre-représentations">Les quatre représentations</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">par</span>(<span class="at">mfrow =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="dv">2</span>))</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">barplot</span>(<span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome), <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"steelblue"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="at">main =</span> <span class="st">"Diplôme"</span>, <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"effectif"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">pie</span>(<span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>region), <span class="at">main =</span> <span class="st">"Région"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-7" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">hist</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, <span class="at">breaks =</span> bornes, <span class="at">freq =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"steelblue"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-9" tabindex="-1"></a>     <span class="at">main =</span> <span class="st">"Salaire"</span>, <span class="at">xlab =</span> <span class="st">"dirhams"</span>, <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"densité"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-10" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">plot</span>(<span class="fu">ecdf</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire), <span class="at">main =</span> <span class="st">"Cumulative croissante"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-12" tabindex="-1"></a>     <span class="at">xlab =</span> <span class="st">"dirhams"</span>, <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"F(x)"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="les-quatre-représentations-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-quatre-représentations-suite">Les quatre représentations (suite)</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’argument qui compte : freq = FALSE</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Avec <code>freq = TRUE</code> (le défaut), <code>hist</code> trace les <strong>effectifs</strong> : l’histogramme est faux dès que les amplitudes sont inégales.</p>
<p><code>freq = FALSE</code> trace les <strong>densités</strong> — la règle du chapitre 3. <strong>À écrire systématiquement.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-boîte-à-moustaches">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-boîte-à-moustaches">La boîte à moustaches</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb8-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">boxplot</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal,</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-2" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="st">"steelblue"</span>, <span class="st">"orange"</span>, <span class="st">"seagreen"</span>),</span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-3" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"salaire (dirhams)"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La syntaxe formule</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>y ~ x</code> se lit « <span class="math inline">y</span> <strong>selon</strong> <span class="math inline">x</span> ». C’est la notation centrale de R, et elle servira à toute la modélisation.</p>
<p>Ici elle produit directement les distributions <strong>conditionnelles</strong> du chapitre 11.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="les-indicateurs-univariés">
<h1>Les indicateurs univariés</h1>
<section class="level2" id="tendance-centrale-et-dispersion">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="tendance-centrale-et-dispersion">Tendance centrale et dispersion</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb9-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-1" tabindex="-1"></a>x <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(x)                        <span class="co"># 7158.26</span></span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">median</span>(x)                      <span class="co"># 6770</span></span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">quantile</span>(x, <span class="fu">c</span>(.<span class="dv">10</span>,.<span class="dv">25</span>,.<span class="dv">50</span>,.<span class="dv">75</span>,.<span class="dv">90</span>))</span>
<span id="cb9-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">IQR</span>(x)                         <span class="co"># 3012</span></span>
<span id="cb9-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">var</span>(x)  <span class="sc">*</span> (n<span class="dv">-1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n              <span class="co"># 6750122   variance descriptive</span></span>
<span id="cb9-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(x)   <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="fu">sqrt</span>((n<span class="dv">-1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n)        <span class="co"># 2598.10   écart-type descriptif</span></span>
<span id="cb9-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(x)<span class="sc">/</span><span class="fu">mean</span>(x)                  <span class="co"># 0.363     coefficient de variation</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le piège n contre n-1</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><strong>R divise par <span class="math inline">n-1</span>, pas par <span class="math inline">n</span>.</strong> <code>var()</code> calcule la variance dite corrigée, celle de l’inférentielle.</p>
<p>La variance <strong>descriptive</strong> du chapitre 7 divise par <span class="math inline">n</span>. D’où la correction <code>* (n-1)/n</code>.</p>
<p>Sur <span class="math inline">500</span> observations l’écart est de <span class="math inline">0{,}2\,\%</span> — négligeable en pratique, mais il faut savoir qu’il existe, et il devient sensible sur de petits échantillons. <strong>Un étudiant qui trouve un écart avec son calcul manuel doit vérifier ce point en premier.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="forme-et-concentration">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="forme-et-concentration">Forme et concentration</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb10-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">library</span>(moments)</span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">skewness</span>(x)                    <span class="co"># 1.164   asymétrie</span></span>
<span id="cb10-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">kurtosis</span>(x)                    <span class="co"># 4.837   aplatissement, référence 3</span></span>
<span id="cb10-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-5" tabindex="-1"></a>gini <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="cf">function</span>(v) {</span>
<span id="cb10-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-6" tabindex="-1"></a>  v <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sort</span>(v); n <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">length</span>(v)</span>
<span id="cb10-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-7" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dv">2</span><span class="sc">*</span><span class="fu">sum</span>(<span class="fu">seq_len</span>(n)<span class="sc">*</span>v)<span class="sc">/</span>(n<span class="sc">*</span><span class="fu">sum</span>(v)) <span class="sc">-</span> (n<span class="sc">+</span><span class="dv">1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n</span>
<span id="cb10-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-8" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb10-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb10-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">gini</span>(x)                        <span class="co"># 0.195</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-courbe-de-lorenz">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-courbe-de-lorenz">La courbe de Lorenz</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb11-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Courbe de Lorenz</span></span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-2" tabindex="-1"></a>v <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sort</span>(x)</span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-3" tabindex="-1"></a>F <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">seq_len</span>(n)<span class="sc">/</span>n</span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-4" tabindex="-1"></a>Q <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">cumsum</span>(v)<span class="sc">/</span><span class="fu">sum</span>(v)</span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">plot</span>(<span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>,F), <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>,Q), <span class="at">type =</span> <span class="st">"l"</span>, <span class="at">lwd =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"steelblue"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-6" tabindex="-1"></a>     <span class="at">xlab =</span> <span class="st">"part cumulée des salariés"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb11-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-7" tabindex="-1"></a>     <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"part cumulée de la masse salariale"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb11-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb11-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">abline</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"grey50"</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="forme-et-concentration-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="forme-et-concentration-suite">Forme et concentration (suite)</h2>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Vérifier la convention d’aplatissement</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>moments::kurtosis()</code> donne <span class="math inline">\gamma_2</span>, dont la référence est <span class="math inline">3</span>.</p>
<p>D’autres implémentations donnent l’<strong>excès</strong> <span class="math inline">\gamma_2 - 3</span>, de référence <span class="math inline">0</span>. Sur les mêmes données, on lirait alors <span class="math inline">1{,}84</span>.</p>
<p>Les deux sont justes ; il faut savoir laquelle on regarde.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="le-bivarié">
<h1>Le bivarié</h1>
<section class="level2" id="contingence">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="contingence">Contingence</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb12"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb12-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb12-1" tabindex="-1"></a>T <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome, sal<span class="sc">$</span>region)</span>
<span id="cb12-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb12-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">addmargins</span>(T)                         <span class="co"># avec les marges</span></span>
<span id="cb12-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb12-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">prop.table</span>(T, <span class="dv">1</span>), <span class="dv">3</span>)            <span class="co"># profils-lignes</span></span>
<span id="cb12-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb12-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">prop.table</span>(T, <span class="dv">2</span>), <span class="dv">3</span>)            <span class="co"># profils-colonnes</span></span>
<span id="cb12-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb12-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">round</span>(<span class="fu">chisq.test</span>(T)<span class="sc">$</span>expected, <span class="dv">1</span>)      <span class="co"># effectifs théoriques</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">L’argument margin de prop.table</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>1</code> divise par les totaux de <strong>ligne</strong>, <code>2</code> par les totaux de <strong>colonne</strong>, rien du tout par le total général.</p>
<p>C’est exactement la distinction conjointe / profil-ligne / profil-colonne du chapitre 10 — et l’erreur d’interprétation la plus fréquente tient à ce seul argument.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="conditionnelles-et-décomposition-de-la-variance">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="conditionnelles-et-décomposition-de-la-variance">Conditionnelles et décomposition de la variance</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb13-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Moyennes et écarts-types conditionnels</span></span>
<span id="cb13-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">aggregate</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal,</span>
<span id="cb13-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-3" tabindex="-1"></a>          <span class="at">FUN =</span> <span class="cf">function</span>(v) <span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="at">n =</span> <span class="fu">length</span>(v), <span class="at">moy =</span> <span class="fu">mean</span>(v), <span class="at">et =</span> <span class="fu">sd</span>(v)))</span>
<span id="cb13-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Décomposition de la variance</span></span>
<span id="cb13-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-6" tabindex="-1"></a>g   <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">split</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome)</span>
<span id="cb13-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-7" tabindex="-1"></a>nj  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sapply</span>(g, length)</span>
<span id="cb13-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-8" tabindex="-1"></a>mj  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sapply</span>(g, mean)</span>
<span id="cb13-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-9" tabindex="-1"></a>vj  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sapply</span>(g, <span class="cf">function</span>(v) <span class="fu">mean</span>((v <span class="sc">-</span> <span class="fu">mean</span>(v))<span class="sc">^</span><span class="dv">2</span>))</span>
<span id="cb13-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-10" tabindex="-1"></a>mg  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">mean</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire)</span>
<span id="cb13-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-11" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-12" tabindex="-1"></a>intra <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(nj<span class="sc">*</span>vj)<span class="sc">/</span>n                  <span class="co"># 5010426</span></span>
<span id="cb13-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-13" tabindex="-1"></a>inter <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sum</span>(nj<span class="sc">*</span>(mj <span class="sc">-</span> mg)<span class="sc">^</span><span class="dv">2</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n         <span class="co"># 1739696</span></span>
<span id="cb13-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb13-14" tabindex="-1"></a>eta2  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> inter<span class="sc">/</span>(intra <span class="sc">+</span> inter)         <span class="co"># 0.258</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le contrôle à faire</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>intra + inter</code> doit redonner la variance descriptive totale, <span class="math inline">6\,750\,122</span>.</p>
<p>Si ce n’est pas le cas, c’est presque toujours que <code>vj</code> a été calculé avec <code>var()</code>, donc en <span class="math inline">n-1</span>. Le contrôle détecte l’erreur immédiatement.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="covariance-corrélation-ajustement">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="covariance-corrélation-ajustement">Covariance, corrélation, ajustement</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb14"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb14-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-1" tabindex="-1"></a>y <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire</span>
<span id="cb14-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-2" tabindex="-1"></a>z <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sal<span class="sc">$</span>anciennete</span>
<span id="cb14-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb14-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cov</span>(z, y) <span class="sc">*</span> (n<span class="dv">-1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n            <span class="co"># 9859.9   covariance descriptive</span></span>
<span id="cb14-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cor</span>(z, y)                      <span class="co"># 0.6363   coefficient de corrélation</span></span>
<span id="cb14-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">cor</span>(z, y)<span class="sc">^</span><span class="dv">2</span>                    <span class="co"># 0.4049   coefficient de détermination</span></span>
<span id="cb14-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-7" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb14-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-8" tabindex="-1"></a>mod <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)</span>
<span id="cb14-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb14-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">summary</span>(mod)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La sortie de lm()</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<pre><code>Coefficients:
             Estimate
(Intercept)  4347.2
anciennete    277.17

Multiple R-squared:  0.4049</code></pre>
<p><span class="math inline">\hat a = 4\,347</span>, <span class="math inline">\hat b = 277</span>, <span class="math inline">r^2 = 0{,}405</span> : les valeurs du chapitre 13, retrouvées à l’identique.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="le-graphique-final">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-graphique-final">Le graphique final</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb16"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb16-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb16-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">plot</span>(z, y, <span class="at">pch =</span> <span class="dv">20</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="fu">rgb</span>(<span class="dv">0</span>,<span class="dv">0</span>,<span class="dv">1</span>,<span class="fl">0.35</span>),</span>
<span id="cb16-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb16-2" tabindex="-1"></a>     <span class="at">xlab =</span> <span class="st">"ancienneté (années)"</span>, <span class="at">ylab =</span> <span class="st">"salaire (dirhams)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb16-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb16-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">abline</span>(mod, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"orange"</span>, <span class="at">lwd =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>)</span>
<span id="cb16-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb16-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">points</span>(<span class="fu">mean</span>(z), <span class="fu">mean</span>(y), <span class="at">pch =</span> <span class="dv">19</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"darkviolet"</span>, <span class="at">cex =</span> <span class="fl">1.4</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le contrôle visuel</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Le point moyen doit être <strong>sur</strong> la droite. S’il ne l’est pas, le calcul est faux — c’est la propriété du chapitre 13, et elle sert ici de test.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="le-script-complet">
<h1>Le script complet</h1>
<section class="level2" id="quinze-lignes">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="quinze-lignes">Quinze lignes</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb17"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb17-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-1" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-2" tabindex="-1"></a>n   <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">nrow</span>(sal); x <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire; z <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> sal<span class="sc">$</span>anciennete</span>
<span id="cb17-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="at">moyenne =</span> <span class="fu">mean</span>(x), <span class="at">mediane =</span> <span class="fu">median</span>(x),</span>
<span id="cb17-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-5" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="at">ecart_type =</span> <span class="fu">sd</span>(x)<span class="sc">*</span><span class="fu">sqrt</span>((n<span class="dv">-1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n), <span class="at">CV =</span> <span class="fu">sd</span>(x)<span class="sc">/</span><span class="fu">mean</span>(x))</span>
<span id="cb17-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">quantile</span>(x, <span class="fu">c</span>(.<span class="dv">10</span>,.<span class="dv">25</span>,.<span class="dv">50</span>,.<span class="dv">75</span>,.<span class="dv">90</span>))</span>
<span id="cb17-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="at">asym =</span> moments<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">skewness</span>(x), <span class="at">aplat =</span> moments<span class="sc">::</span><span class="fu">kurtosis</span>(x))</span>
<span id="cb17-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">gini</span>(x)</span>
<span id="cb17-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-9" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome, sal<span class="sc">$</span>region)</span>
<span id="cb17-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">aggregate</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> diplome, sal, mean)</span>
<span id="cb17-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-12" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">c</span>(<span class="at">cov =</span> <span class="fu">cov</span>(z,x)<span class="sc">*</span>(n<span class="dv">-1</span>)<span class="sc">/</span>n, <span class="at">r =</span> <span class="fu">cor</span>(z,x), <span class="at">r2 =</span> <span class="fu">cor</span>(z,x)<span class="sc">^</span><span class="dv">2</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb17-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">coef</span>(<span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete, <span class="at">data =</span> sal))</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Ce que ce script produit</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><strong>Tout le cours.</strong> Les douze indicateurs univariés, le tableau croisé, les conditionnelles, la corrélation et la droite.</p>
<p>Ce qui a demandé quatorze chapitres tient en quinze lignes — et c’est bien ainsi. <strong>Le semestre n’a jamais servi à apprendre à calculer, mais à savoir ce qu’on calcule et comment le lire.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-quil-faut-retenir">
<h1>Ce qu’il faut retenir</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">Le résumé du chapitre</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Six points</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li><code>str()</code> d’abord : vérifier que chaque variable a le <strong>bon type</strong>.</li>
<li><code>cut(..., right = FALSE)</code> pour des classes <span class="math inline">[a\,;\,b[</span> à la française.</li>
<li><code>hist(..., freq = FALSE)</code> pour tracer des <strong>densités</strong>, pas des effectifs.</li>
<li><code>var()</code> et <code>sd()</code> divisent par <strong><span class="math inline">n-1</span></strong> : corriger par <span class="math inline">(n-1)/n</span> pour la variance descriptive.</li>
<li><code>prop.table(T, 1)</code> et <code>prop.table(T, 2)</code> : profils-lignes et profils-colonnes, à ne pas confondre.</li>
<li>La syntaxe <code>y ~ x</code> est la clé de R : <code>boxplot</code>, <code>aggregate</code>, <code>lm</code> l’emploient toutes.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La suite</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Le chapitre 15 refait exactement la même chaîne en Python, avec pandas et matplotlib — et retrouve les mêmes nombres.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>

```
